changes.visibleDownloadOrder: Artist ASCII NOCASE, album ASCII NOCASE, download date ascending, using current canonical metadata before sorting.
changes.collation: ASCII A-Z folding only and UTF-8 byte order; no locale/accent normalization.
changes.deterministicTieBreak: Track ID ascending. APK SQL leaves complete ties unspecified.
changes.atomicMissingPointerRetirement: One files readwrite transaction rereads the row and deletes only if its cacheKey equals the stage actually observed missing.
changes.visibleDownloadBadges: Authoritative local listing reconciles completed IDs while protecting current jobs, removals, overlapping reads and player-side corrections.

controlledBrowsers.consolidation: For each engine select nine passing v1 checks and the two corrected new cases from v2. The three repeated setup/selection checks per engine in v2 are not added.

v1.reason: Both new cases assumed twelve search rows before clicking the real Ver más control. They failed in preparation before downloading; the existing nine checks per engine passed. Raw results remain unchanged.

v2.reason: Only the UI preparation expands the twelve search results before its unchanged twelve-row assertion. Product, download, ordering, decoder, storage and outage assertions remain unchanged.

controlledBrowsers.countScope: Eleven checks per engine: two setup checks, selection baseline and eight selected media scenarios. Not 33 distinct product features.
controlledBrowsers.scope: Compiled PWA, HTTP provider fixtures and genuine silent AAC, native HTMLAudio, IDB, CacheStorage and production service worker. Desktop browsers with mobile layouts.
controlledBrowsers.outageScope: The scenario report records the actual offline or origin/provider outage mode. A WebKit HTTP gate is not physical airplane mode.
controlledBrowsers.syntheticCacheEviction: Only the missing-cache scenario removes a previously product-downloaded cache body as a fault. No QA download-row insertion, replacement player, live-provider or physical-device claim.
